nodes.label: SFT using Olmo-core
nodes.rationale: Observed ~8x compute efficiency running SFT on an OLMo 7B model with Olmo-core vs open-instruct, from a more efficient training codebase plus better dataloading via a bin-packing algorithm. The 'launch' command creates a Beaker experiment and reruns the same command remotely with 'train' substituted. Currently supported scripts: Olmo-2-7B, Olmo-3-7B, Olmo-3-32B; new base models require a new script configuring parallelism for that architecture.

nodes.label: SFT Dataset Prep (open-instruct)
nodes.rationale: Datasets are prepared via open-instruct (mason.py + convert_sft_data_for_olmocore.py), e.g. Dolci-Think-SFT-32B (1x) plus tool-use mixes (3x). It is critical to use the 'olmo' chat template so a single [eos] token marks document boundaries, enabling correct document packing; download the tokenizer locally (e.g. Weka) first to avoid repeated downloads.

nodes.label: SFT Eval & HF Conversion
nodes.rationale: Convert checkpoints to HuggingFace via convert_checkpoint_to_hf.py (custom architectures such as hybrid FLA models use convert_checkpoint_to_hf_hybrid.py). Verify chat template and tokenizer before evals — e.g. OLMo 3 Think models were trained with the Instruct chat template but need a template adding <think> to add_generation_prompt for evals. Evals are launched via open-instruct submit_eval_jobs.py.
